patterns.note: Generous vertical spacing between major content sections, creating an airy and uncrowded feel, particularly in the hero and testimonial areas.
Prominent, elegant serif typography is used for all primary headings and hero text, contrasting with clean, understated sans-serif for body copy and navigation.
A high-contrast dark mode is used for the initial hero, transitioning to a light mode for subsequent content, with a consistent bright blue accent for interactive elements.

The hero section transforms on scroll: an initial dark, text-focused hero with a small image grid transitions to a light-grey background featuring a prominent 3D architectural model, while the main hero text remains in place.
A sticky navigation bar with a light background and primary links appears after initial scroll, replacing the initial minimal header.
Numbered lists are used for service offerings, providing a clear, structured overview of capabilities.

technique_notes: The hero section uses a scroll-triggered state change: an initial dark, text-only hero transitions to a lighter background with a prominent 3D canvas model as the user scrolls down. The main hero text remains fixed relative to the viewport during this transition, while a new sticky navigation bar appears at the top.
Content sections below the hero appear to reveal with a subtle fade-in or slide-up animation as they enter the viewport, enhancing engagement as the user scrolls.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, elegant serif headings (~4-5x body) paired with clean, legible sans-serif body text and small uppercase labels.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp (all corners are 0-2px, giving a crisp, modern feel).
design_tokens.spacing: Airy (generous vertical spacing, especially in hero and between major content blocks, creating a sense of calm and luxury).

standout: The most distinctive feature is the dynamic hero section that transforms on scroll, transitioning from a dark, text-heavy introduction to a lighter, visually rich scene with a 3D architectural model, all while maintaining the core message. This creates a highly engaging and memorable first impression.
